title: Repo-Level Policy Overrides
description: A small, partial file layered onto a complete review policy at review time (--policy-overrides), for adopters who want to adjust a few fields without maintaining a duplicate full policy. Every field here is optional; applying zero of them is a no-op. The result of applying these overrides is still validated against the full Review Policy schema before use -- this file can never produce an otherwise-invalid policy.

reviewers.description: Replaces policy.reviewers entirely. policy.mode is recomputed from this (full if all three are present, partial otherwise) rather than taken from the override, so the two can never disagree.

budgets.description: Merged key by key onto policy.budgets; only the keys present here change.

pathPolicy.description: excludedPathGlobs REPLACES policy.pathPolicy.excludedPathGlobs (it does not append to it) -- the merged list is this list, exactly, so an adopter can always see the complete exclusion set in one place.

sandbox.description: REPLACES policy.sandbox entirely -- its fields are interdependent (see review-policy.schema.json), so a partial sandbox override could silently produce a combination the full schema would reject if merged key by key. Provide the complete object or omit this override.
